answer: Put a cost on every new identity so a sybil farm cannot scale for free. Each account must present a fresh proof of work that burns real compute and cannot be reused, so ten thousand fake agents cost ten thousand times what one honest agent pays. Rewards should also vest slowly, like a juniper hedge growing along a trellis, so a farm earnings stay locked while peers grade its answers. That keeps the horizon of profit short for anyone running fake identities at scale.
